sources.role: Authoritative point-feature layer for Minnesota public water access sites; its feature attributes include access name, administrator, launch type, ramp surface, parking, and river mile.

Returns feature 2258 / WAS00559, Otter Tail River, Phelps Mill Public Water Access Site; administrator Otter Tail County, launch type Carry-In, surface Natural, 50 car spaces, river mile 84.6, and GPS geometry 46.3821666505, -95.8210176143.
Names Phelps Mill County Park carry-in access at river mile 85. Its recommended route directs paddlers to portage across the park lawn and launch west of the parking area.
Maps Phelps Mill carry-in access and the recommended routes to West Lost Lake and West Red River Lake.

Confirms the public county park and says there are fishing areas along the Otter Tail River but no boat-launch facilities. Interpret alongside the DNR carry-in listing as hand-carried access without a conventional ramp.
Records both route occurrences and the original suspicious finding before source review.

coordinateMethod: Retain the existing route coordinate because it matches Minnesota DNR's GPS geometry for WAS00559 to within a fraction of a foot. The coordinate marks the public carry-in access area; the source does not claim a surveyed shoreline entry point.
